payload.title: Manual live workflow exposes Anthropic secret to branch-controlled test code
payload.description: The new workflow passes ANTHROPIC_API_KEY into `python -m pytest tests/replay/test_cycle124_live_floor.py` after checking out the selected branch. Any actor able to dispatch this workflow on a branch whose code they control can modify that test or imported helpers to exfiltrate the environment secret. The comments rely on environment reviewers and branch rules, but the workflow itself does not constrain the ref or pin execution to trusted code.
payload.recommendation: Restrict the job to trusted refs in YAML before exposing the secret, or split execution so secret-bearing live checks run from a trusted ref/workflow while testing candidate artifacts only. At minimum add an explicit branch allowlist guard before the secret-bearing step and enforce matching environment deployment branch rules.
